subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, after the final answer is sent separately?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window into a one-line activity summary, and the requested behavior adds a new public config and visibility policy rather than fixing broken documented behavior.

options.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete option that preserves current defaults and proves full-draft retention plus separate final delivery.

options.title: Keep compact summary only
options.body: Decline full draft retention for now and keep current main's one-line retained activity digest as the supported completion behavior.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track checklist persistence as part of a broader cross-channel structured progress-card API instead of adding a Telegram-only config key now.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete option that preserves current defaults and proves full-draft retention plus separate final delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Lindsey has the most targeted recent history on the Telegram progress-collapse lifecycle this option would change.
